attributes.action: Give grants to ALL schools to install air conditioning.
attributes.additional_details: Getting a grant for EVERY school in England and wales to install air conditioning. We need to find ways to deal with such heat and high temperatures because this will be more common now than we realise.
attributes.background: I want to all schools in England and wales to be able to access a grant to be able to install air conditioning. This will prevent working parents losing even more money finding childcare. Also if we stay at work we keep money in the system. Our children don't lose out on education.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

Legislate a statutory maximum temperature for classrooms and fund school cooling
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/774023
